title: Same-session serialization test is not deterministic about the locked operation order
reasoning: The comments describe refresh taking the lock first, but the test starts refreshNow and signOut as concurrent async lets with no synchronization point proving which operation entered the lock first. The final signed-out assertion can pass for several implementations that simply delete eventually, without proving refresh and signOut cannot interleave in the critical section.
recommendation: Introduce a gated refresh stub or actor test hook that confirms refresh has entered the locked region before signOut is started, then assert signOut completes only after the refresh gate is released and the final state is signed out.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current assertion checks only final keychain state, not the ordering or non-interleaving behavior the test title promises.
suggestedRegressionTest: Hold refreshNow inside the session lock with a controllable stub, start signOut, assert signOut is pending while the gate is closed, release the gate, then assert signOut completes and deletes the row.
minimumFixScope: Tighten SessionLockTests.sameSessionOperationsAreSerializedRefreshThenSignOut with deterministic synchronization around lock acquisition and release.
